wording: The agent tracks at least some internally generated capability changes rather than only environmental uncertainty.

decision_rule.retain_if: With external difficulty held fixed, self-monitor mean absolute error to true success probability is >=0.05 lower than world-only uncertainty, mean self-estimate decreases by >=0.10 under internal impairment, world-only estimate changes by <=0.02, and at least 18/20 seeds show the self-monitor MAE advantage.
decision_rule.restrict_if: Self-specific tracking appears only for one impairment type or capability boundary.
decision_rule.reduce_if: World-only uncertainty reproduces the decisive calibration and impairment-tracking effects.
decision_rule.reject_if: The nominated self-estimate does not track internally generated capability change.
